title: JavaScript Essentials
outcome: In this course, you will learn concepts such as Events, Scope, Hoisting, and Asynchronous JavaScript. You will also learn about ES6 classes, Error Handling, and more about JavaScript objects.
why: By learning about concepts such as events, scope, hoisting, and asynchronous JavaScript, you will gain a deeper understanding of how the language works and be able to write more effective code.
